entry.content:
Pringle of Scotland has spent more than two centuries designing knitwear, with cashmere and argyle as its signatures. For this collaboration, Vans puts that argyle on three of its skate classics: the Authentic 44, the Classic Slip-On 98 and the Sk8-Hi Reissue 38, in navy or black with marshmallow white. The Slip-On carries a collaboration logo at the heel, with the Vans logo below it on the sidewall. The collection also includes sweaters, vests, track sets, beanies, socks and a tote, made for winter adventures and sweater weather.

entry.content:
Ford built the Bronco Frostwarden to withstand the extreme conditions of Arctic search and rescue. Its 42-inch BFGoodrich tires and portal axles lift the body for extra ground clearance, and a black-and-yellow rescue livery helps it stand out in bleak weather. A winch up front, traction boards and a spare tire on the roof give it the look and readiness of a winter recovery truck. It also debuts the Megazilla 2.0, a supercharged V8 that Ford says out-muscles every crate engine from any automaker, with more than 1,200 horsepower and more than 1,000 pound-feet of torque on race fuel. Ford built just one Frostwarden, and it is not for sale.

entry.title: Wolfbox FlexPilot Dash Cam
entry.summary: Wolfbox expands visibility beyond the windshield with the FlexPilot multi-angle dash cam. Built for daily commutes, off-road adventures, and long-haul travel, the FlexPilot system has five camera options allowing drivers to configure up to two 4k and two 1080p cameras around thei
entry.content:
Wolfbox expands visibility beyond the windshield with the FlexPilot multi-angle dash cam. Built for daily commutes, off-road adventures, and long-haul travel, the FlexPilot system has five camera options allowing drivers to configure up to two 4k and two 1080p cameras around their vehicle. The dual 4K cameras feature Sony IMX678 STARVIS 2 sensors and Ambarella image processing for improved low-light performance and dynamic range capturing everything from blind spots to the rugged terrain on off-road trails. A 1,500-nit adaptive display works with OEM brackets for easy installation and allows drivers to customize camera layouts, while blind-spot detection, driver assistance alerts, and HDR imaging add functionality. Designed for an OEM-style fit without drilling, FlexPilot launches on Kickstarter November 17 with a 35% off early-bird special now live. Deliveries expected in spring 2027.

entry.content:
Americans who want a Japanese kei truck, a tiny pickup built to work, have mostly had to import one used. But starting in 2027, Toyota will offer the Scion KEI-01, the first vehicle from the revived Scion brand. It measures a little over 11 feet bumper to bumper and less than 5 feet across, with a bed that folds down on three sides, a 600-pound limit and a heated, air-conditioned cab. It has a three-cylinder engine of 660cc and standard four-wheel drive, but it follows low-speed vehicle rules and tops out at 25 mph. It is created for ranchers, farmers, campuses and delivery services. It will be built in Indiana and sold first to fleet customers.

entry.content:
Sonos takes home theater audio to another level with the Arc Ultra, a sleek soundbar delivering a 9.1.4 spatial audio experience with Dolby Atmos. At its core is Sound Motion™ technology, a first-of-its-kind transducer that doubles the bass output of the original Arc while taking up significantly less space. Fourteen Sonos-engineered drivers, including seven tweeters and six midwoofers, create an expansive soundstage with precise placement, immersive height channels, and crisp dialogue. Advanced Speech Enhancement boosts vocal clarity for TV and movies, while Trueplay automatically calibrates audio to the room. Beyond the screen, the Arc Ultra doubles as a high-performance music speaker, streaming over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Apple AirPlay 2 even when the TV is off. It can also serve as the centerpiece of a larger Sonos system, pairing with compatible speakers and a Sub for a more enveloping setup. Finished in a slim, curved design with a wraparound grille, it connects via HDMI eARC and brings cinematic sound and room-filling music together in one refined package.

entry.content:
Onkyo marks its 80th anniversary with the HA-70, a desktop headphone amplifier built on the idea that headphones have become many listeners' favorite way to hear music. It gives each channel its own converter chip and keeps the signal fully balanced from start to finish, which Onkyo says brings out clarity and detail. Three power settings let it work with everything from earbud-style monitors to large headphones that need more power to sound their best. A large volume knob sits in the center of the aluminum body, flanked by two headphone jacks, and the whole amp is small enough for a desk. Coming Spring 2027.

entry.content:
More than 4,700 people applied for one of 250 Jeep Wrangler Commando 392s, and Jeep set 249 aside for active-duty troops and veterans. The last one, the only Commando anyone else can buy, is up for auction, and every dollar of the winning bid goes to the USO. Painted '41 gloss Army Green, it carries USO and Commando graphics on the hood, and the odometer reads only about 220 miles. A Whipple supercharger lifts the 6.4-liter Hemi V8 to 705 horsepower. For rough ground, it adds a 3.5-inch lift, Fox shocks, 37-inch Nitto tires and a Warn winch.

entry.title: Peson Namsen Rowing Boat
entry.summary: Kjell Pettersson, a boatbuilder who guided salmon anglers on Norway's Namsen River, became tired of the regular upkeep that wooden rowboats need and decided to build a replacement that would withstand the weather with less effort. The Peson Namsen keeps the shape of the tradition
entry.content:
Kjell Pettersson, a boatbuilder who guided salmon anglers on Norway's Namsen River, became tired of the regular upkeep that wooden rowboats need and decided to build a replacement that would withstand the weather with less effort. The Peson Namsen keeps the shape of the traditional hull, with its keel, ribs and rows of side planks, but swaps the timber for plastic that is welded from solid HDPE. The boat can stay outside all season, doesn't take on water and never requires caulking, paint or sanding. It is about 15 feet long and seats three, and it ships with oars, a mooring rope and a bailer. A small outboard of up to 5 horsepower fits too. Stainless steel rod holders and a folding seat are optional.

entry.content:
Frank Frazetta turned down a baseball contract from the New York Giants and chose a career in art instead. Nearly all of his paintings illustrated characters other writers had invented, the exception was the Death Dealer, a faceless warrior in a horned helmet. He painted the original in 1973, and Death Dealer II followed in 1986, later becoming the cover of the first novel in a book series about the character. The 1973 warrior sits on horseback over a battlefield, while this one stands on a pile of fallen creatures with his axe raised, as clawed, snake-like shapes surge up out of the dark. Nearly everything is a cool blue-gray, and the only red comes from his eyes, a streak in the sky and a blaze of firelight behind him. Frazetta made the painting as he got back to work after years of illness and kept it until he died. This is the first time it has gone up for auction.
